rationale: The material prompt requirement is Figma node context, screenshot/assets retrieval, production UI implementation, and 1:1 visual-parity verification. At # Markdown for Agents, the source is scoped to 'Make every website page AI-agent-friendly by shipping a Markdown version of each page so agents consume content at a fraction of the tokens. Provider-neutral core: per-page meta tags + JSON-LD + a static .md mirror per page + sitemap submission + the /llms.txt site index. Includes the Cloudflare "Markdown for Agents" edge-conversion option for sites on Clou; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
